u0: The agent has not yet flipped the switch, so the exit must not be reached at this point. It needs to flip the switch at least once and then reach the exit to succeed. Stepping onto the exit before any switch flip fails the task, while stepping onto the exit after flipping completes it.
u1: The switch has been flipped at least once and the exit has not yet been reached. The remaining objective is simply to reach the exit, and doing so completes the task; no failure is possible from this state.
u2: The agent stepped onto the exit without ever having flipped the switch, violating the ordering requirement. This is an irreversible failure: successful completion is no longer possible and the task ends unsuccessfully.
u3: The exit has been reached after the switch had been flipped at least once, so both requirements are satisfied. The task is complete and successful.
